target.definition: Total value of New Zealand's goods exports in March 2026, actual monthly value not seasonally adjusted, as first reported in Stats NZ's Overseas merchandise trade release.

inputs.name: annual_goods_exports_nzd
inputs.description: Total NZ annual goods exports value in the year to March 2026

provenance.rationale: Recent NZ annual goods exports have run roughly NZD 70-75b; dairy, meat, logs and fruit dominate.

inputs.name: march_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Share of annual goods exports falling in March, reflecting March seasonality (dairy peak tail, fruit, logs)

provenance.rationale: March is typically a strong month, slightly above the 1/12 = 8.3% average.

inputs.name: monthly_export_value_nzd
inputs.description: Typical recent monthly goods export value (average month)

provenance.rationale: Annual ~72b divided by 12 gives ~6b per month.

inputs.name: march_seasonal_factor
inputs.description: Ratio of March exports to an average month

provenance.rationale: March tends to be modestly above average due to dairy and horticulture timing.

inputs.name: dairy_export_value_nzd
inputs.description: NZ dairy goods export value in March 2026

provenance.rationale: Dairy is roughly a third of goods exports; March is near the seasonal peak of dairy product shipments.

inputs.name: meat_export_value_nzd
inputs.description: NZ meat and edible offal export value in March 2026

provenance.rationale: Meat is ~15% of goods exports; March is a solid processing/shipping month.

inputs.name: other_exports_value_nzd
inputs.description: All other goods exports (logs, fruit, machinery, seafood, aluminium, etc.) in March 2026

provenance.rationale: Remainder of monthly exports after dairy and meat, including forestry and horticulture.

inputs.name: nz_gdp_nzd
inputs.description: NZ annual nominal GDP

provenance.rationale: NZ nominal GDP is around NZD 400-430b.

inputs.name: exports_share_of_gdp
inputs.description: Goods exports as a share of nominal GDP

provenance.rationale: Goods exports have recently been about 16-18% of GDP.

inputs.name: months_per_year
inputs.description: Number of months in a year

provenance.rationale: Calendar constant.

paths.description: Allocate annual goods exports to March using March's seasonal share
Sum major commodity groups' March export values
Scale GDP by exports share and apply March seasonal factor

problems: path p3: dimension mismatch: the formula gives count per time (s**-1), but the target needs a pure number, a count or a share (dimensionless). The formula has one 'per time' more than the target; inputs with a time unit in this path: months_per_year ('months'). If the target is a total over a period, multiply by an input whose unit is a length of time: the period itself (for example days_in_period with unit 'day'), or period_length = 1 with unit 'year' when a share of the year then picks the part you need. A share, or a ratio such as 'days/year', has no time unit and does not cancel it.
